shelters.name: Rhode Island SPCA
shelters.description: Founded 1870, oldest humane animal welfare organization in Rhode Island and third oldest in the US. Private nonprofit receiving no local or federal funding.

shelters.name: Providence Animal Rescue League
shelters.description: 100+ year-old 501(c)(3) urban animal shelter. Receives no federal/state funding. Provides care, medical treatment, and adoption services to 2,000+ animals annually.

shelters.name: Animal Rescue Rhode Island
shelters.description: Dedicated to rescuing companion animals in need and the humane welfare of homeless animals.

shelters.name: Robert Potter League for Animals
shelters.description: One of Rhode Island's largest animal welfare organizations serving the Newport County area.

shelters.name: EGAPL Heart of Rhode Island
shelters.description: Animal rescue serving the heart of Rhode Island with adoption and rescue services.

shelters.name: Friends of Providence Animal Care & Control Center
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit supporting Providence Animal Care & Control Center and fostering humane care of animals in the city.

shelters.name: Rhode Home Rescue
shelters.description: 100% volunteer run, 501(c)(3) foster-based dog rescue. Pulls dogs from high kill shelters, abuse and neglect situations, and owner surrenders.

shelters.name: City of Providence Animal Control
shelters.description: City animal control with 'low risk euthanasia' philosophy since 2015. Works to improve live release rate via adoptions, returns, and rescue transfers.

shelters.name: North Providence Animal Welfare Society
shelters.description: 100% volunteer nonprofit 501(c)(3) committed to advocating for shelter services while helping keep pets out of the shelter system.

shelters.name: Ten Lives Cat Rescue
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to providing dignity to cats while reducing the homeless cat population.

shelters.name: Can Do Rescue Group
shelters.description: Animal welfare organization founded 2017 serving Rhode Island.

shelters.name: Barrington Services for Animals
shelters.description: Animal welfare organization founded 2002 serving Barrington and surrounding communities.

shelters.name: New England Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Rhode Island and New England region.

shelters.name: Warwick Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Municipal animal shelter serving Warwick and Kent County.

shelters.name: Woonsocket Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Municipal animal shelter serving Woonsocket and northern Rhode Island.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Rhode Island animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Rhode Island SPCA (founded 1870) is the state's oldest and third oldest in the US. Providence Animal Rescue League is 100+ years old. Coverage spans Providence, Warwick, Newport County, Cranston, and surrounding communities.
